I am old now, 78 years, but I still farm my 5 mu like before. My son works in town, sends some money, but the land is mine to manage. I do what I did last year — no need to change much when the rain and the soil are the same.

I split my land like this: 1 mu for cotton on the sandy patch by the road (cotton likes that soil, I always plant it there), and 4 mu for wheat in winter then maize in summer. That is my pattern for many years.

For seeds I buy from the same dealer in town. Improved wheat seed — Jimai variety, what everyone here uses. Maize I buy Zhengdan or Xianyu hybrid, the bag is about 60 yuan, enough for my plot. Cotton I plant Bt cotton seed, it saves spraying for bollworm.

For fertilizer, I think in bags. One bag of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) is 50 kg, costs around 130 yuan. For wheat I spread 2 bags before planting on my 4 mu — that is 25 kg per mu of compound. Then in spring when wheat turns green I top-dress urea, half a bag per mu, about 20 kg urea (so about 9 kg N more). For maize same idea — one bag compound at planting, then urea when knee-high, maybe 25 kg urea per mu. I apply a bit extra because losing the harvest is much worse than spending a little more on fertilizer. My neighbor Old Wang does the same.

Cotton needs more — I put 1.5 bags compound per mu, then urea twice during the season. Cotton on the sandy soil drinks fertilizer fast.

Water — I have well, electric pump. Wheat I water 3 times: before winter, at green-up, at heading. Maize I water 2 times if no rain. Cotton 3 times.

Spraying — wheat I spray maybe 2 times for aphid and powdery mildew. Maize 1 time for borer. Cotton even with Bt I still spray 5 times for aphid, mite, and other bugs.

Tillage — I hire the rotary tiller man, 60 yuan per mu. My back cannot plough anymore.

Yield — last year wheat gave me about 450 kg per mu, maize about 550 kg per mu, cotton seed cotton about 250 kg per mu. I expect similar this year if weather is normal.
